name: Regex Cheatsheet Interactive
summary: Browse and search JavaScript regex tokens — click to copy, then test in the Regex Tester.
description: Interactive regular-expression cheatsheet for the JavaScript (ECMAScript) flavor: character classes, anchors, quantifiers, groups, lookaround, flags, and common recipes. Search and filter by category; click any token to copy.

faqs.question: Which regex flavor is this?
faqs.answer: JavaScript / ECMAScript — the same engine used by Forge’s Regex Tester and your browser.

faqs.question: Can I try a pattern live?
faqs.answer: Copy a token, then open the Regex Tester to match against sample text.

faqs.question: Are lookbehinds supported?
faqs.answer: Yes in modern browsers. Older engines may lack lookbehind.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The cheatsheet is static content in your browser.
